description: This file defines an interface IUriComposer within the namespace Microsoft.eShopWeb.ApplicationCore.Interfaces. It declares a single method ComposePicUri that takes a URI template string and returns a composed picture URI string.

classes.name: IUriComposer
classes.description: An interface that defines a contract for composing picture URIs from templates.

methods.name: ComposePicUri
methods.description: Generates a complete picture URI based on the provided URI template.
